claims.statement: No EXIF or XMP metadata present
claims.limitations: Absence does NOT indicate authenticity or manipulation: WhatsApp, Instagram, X, Facebook and most platforms strip metadata on upload, and generators often write none.
claims.what_would_confirm: Obtain the earliest available copy (ideally the uploader's original file).
claims.why: The file carries no camera or editing metadata.

claims.statement: No C2PA / Content Credentials manifest found
claims.limitations: Absence does NOT indicate authenticity: most media has no C2PA, and platforms strip manifests on re-upload. Many generators do not sign their output.
claims.what_would_confirm: Check earlier copies — the earliest discovered copy is the most likely to retain a manifest.
claims.why: The file carries no embedded provenance manifest.

claims.statement: Embedded generation parameters identify the tool family: Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111/Forge-style parameters); model/checkpoint: sd_xl_base_1.0
claims.limitations: Can in principle be copied onto another image, but natural photographs essentially never carry sampler/seed parameters.
claims.what_would_confirm: Re-generate with the same seed/model to reproduce (where the model is available).
claims.why: The 'parameters' metadata contains generator settings (prompt, sampler, seed, model) written by the generation software itself.

data.prompt: portrait photo of a young woman, city lights bokeh, 85mm, photorealistic
data.raw_excerpt:
portrait photo of a young woman, city lights bokeh, 85mm, photorealistic
Negative prompt: cartoon, lowres
Steps: 30, Sampler: DPM++ 2M Karras, CFG scale: 6.5, Seed: 1928374650, Size: 1024x1024, Model hash: 31e35c80fc, Model: sd_xl_base_1.0, Version: v1.10.1 [DEMO]

claims.statement: Decoded open invisible watermark: Stability AI SDXL reference-pipeline watermark (bit agreement 83%; probability of this agreement by chance ≈ 1.7e-06)
claims.limitations: Only images made with pipelines that kept the default watermarker carry it; many community tools disable it.
claims.why: The DWT-DCT watermark payload used by Stability AI's reference code was recovered. Agreement at this level is extremely unlikely to occur by chance.

claims.statement: ELA: error levels are broadly uniform (p99/median block ratio 1.9)
claims.limitations: ELA is noisy: high-contrast edges, text, smooth skies and recompression all change error levels. Useful for directing attention, not as standalone evidence. Uniform ELA does not show authenticity (fully generated images are often uniform).
claims.why: Regions pasted or regenerated after the last JPEG save often show a different error level.

claims.statement: Sensor-noise residual is broadly consistent (block coefficient of variation 0.11)
claims.limitations: Texture, exposure, denoising and blur all change local noise. Requires visual review of the map; does not identify a generator.
claims.why: Camera images carry roughly uniform sensor noise; spliced or regenerated regions often differ.

claims.statement: Frequency spectrum shows no strong periodic peaks (peak score 2.5)
claims.limitations: Resizing, JPEG 8×8 blocking, screen capture moiré and halftone patterns also create peaks. Modern diffusion models often leave none.
claims.why: Transposed-convolution / upsampling in many GANs and some diffusion decoders leaves grid-like spectral peaks.

claims.limitations: Small, profile or occluded faces may be missed.

claims.statement: Burned-in text read from the media (1 line(s)): DEMO· SYNTHETIC IMAGE
claims.limitations: OCR can misread stylised fonts; verify against the image.
claims.why: Text overlays (captions, watermarks) were read directly from the pixels.

verdict.headline: Fake
reasons: Proof in the file: Embedded generation parameters identify the tool family: Stable Diffusion (AUTOMATIC1111/Forge-style parameters); model/checkpoint: sd_xl_base_1.0.
caveats: A verdict says how the picture was made, not who made it or whether the event it shows happened.
verdict.reliability: Tested on 640 images from AI generators and photo sources it had never seen: right 68% of the time overall — real photos called real 87%, fakes caught 48%; when the verdict is not 'Uncertain' it was right 74%.
verdict.summary: This is very likely fake (AI-generated image) — 99% likely fake.
